def parse_args():
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description="Convert cell masks to polylines with MobileSAM"
    )
    p.add_argument(
        "--weights_path",
        type=str,
        required=True,
        help="Path to MobileSAM weights (mobile_sam.pt)",
    )
    p.add_argument(
        "--output_path",
        type=str,
        required=True,
        help="Output folder (or explicit .csv file path) for the refined masks",
    )
    p.add_argument("--rgb_path", type=str, required=True, help="Path to the RGB image")
    p.add_argument(
        "--csv_path", type=str, required=True, help="Path to the metadata csv"
    )
